name: Health Potion
desc: Restore HP to allied units within 1 tile (scales with caster ATK).

name: Strength Potion
desc: Grant an attack buff to a selected allied unit.

name: Greater Strength Potion
desc: Grant an attack buff to all allied units within 1 tile.

name: Fire Potion
desc: Hurl a burning flask at the target to deal fire damage to enemies.
